Maya Chen: Heads up, cost-preview for PR-4823 looked like -18% but billing sim shows +3%. Is Console showing marginal or amortized numbers?
Samir Patel: Console defaults to amortized (24h) but we have marginal behind API flag. Which rollout?
Maya Chen: https://redwood.internal/rollouts/PR-4823 
Oliver King: Likely cache warmup assumption. Console used fast-warmup heuristic; billing sim ran conservative cold profile. We exposed two preview knobs: mode (amortized|marginal) and cache_profile (fast|conservative|observed). Example: POST /api/cost_preview {"route":"canary-a","mode":"marginal","cache_profile":"observed"}
Gina R.: Also check telemetry sample-rate mismatch. Billing sim ingests 1% sampled token traces; preview uses full synthetic traces. We should surface sample-rate in the UI.
Samir Patel: Proposed UX defaults: amortized + conservative, with tooltip "Why this differs from billing" and an advanced toggle to set marginal/fast.
Maya Chen: If I switch preview to marginal+fast will that reproduce billing sim?
Oliver King: marginal+fast should match warmed-run numbers.
Maya Chen: Tried it  results show +2.8% which aligns. Thanks.
Samir Patel: Action items: 1) show sample-rate badge in preview; 2) surface knobs under advanced settings; 3) add copy about 24h amortization.
Gina R.: Filing telemetry task to align sampled traces and adding a unit test to run preview with sampled input.
deploy-bot: New PR https://redwood.internal/pulls/4891 "console: cost-preview defaults & advanced knobs" by Gina R.
Samir Patel: Also add a warning banner when users pick marginal or fast: "Estimates exclude amortization and assume warmed caches."
Oliver King: Will implement banner and wire API. Gina will add tests and I'll help with UI copy.
Gina R.: On it, creating follow-ups and linking to PR. :thumbsup:
